text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yaaawn...... oh, Ai-chan?
You're up early, huh? It's only 5......

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Because yesterday was... you know?
There was a lot I'd planned that I couldn't get done.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ......I understand. The reason Sky-san... and Pandora-san dragged us out here. I'd like to think I understand it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
But——I don't think I need it.
Right now I want to move forward. I only want to keep my eyes forward.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: If I stand still today, I won't win tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm off to train!
See you later, Kiseki-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, okay. Later——

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (......She's ahead of me, and she's pushing harder than I am......)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
............. Yeah, I can't just sit around resting either.
Alright. I'm gonna——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Phew, phew... phooo.
Hm? The one over there is......

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Bright-san is out training today too.
......She really does run beautifully, as expected.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (It's not about overwhelming your opponent with bursts of speed. It's enduring,biding your time, and then winning it all at the very end — that's her running.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
......Um, Bright-san!
If it's all right with you——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: May I! Run alongside you?

text_block_list.name: Bright & Ai
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaaa!
Haaaaaaahhh......!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(......So this is Bright-san's running!
It's not just a matter of distance aptitude——)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (Bright-san's running has "depth" to it. The effort she's piled up, the experience she's amassed — it seeps through in every single step she drives in......!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hahh, hahh... Bright-san!
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Not at alll. The thanks is mine —
thank you for such a meaningful time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You are no stayer, Ai-sama, yet you ran at my distance for me...... You must be quite spent, no?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not at all! It was a distance I'm not used to, true, but...
I'm glad I did it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I got to feel your strength firsthand, after all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
How about it? More partner training after this!
I'd be delighted if you'd join me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm. I would have liked to as well, but...
a little bit of fatigue has crept in, so I'll call it a day for now.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah... i-is that so?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. I am a take-it-easy sort of girl, you see.
I'll do my best, nice and slow, at my own pace.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
......Understood. Good work on your training!
I look forward to next time!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Phew, phew, phooo... hm?
......Huh? Bright-san?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(She's watching... the girls training? But for what purpose?
Gathering intel on us, or something?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(......No. ......That's not it. I know that look myself.
That's not what it is — that's——)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(——She wants to run, really.
That's the look of someone holding back because of their condition.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ......Bright-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Ai-sama. My apologies.
Was I getting in the way of your training?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all, really!
It's just, I... um——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's so frustrating, isn't it? When your body won't keep up with your heart. 
That happens to me a lot too, so... that's why——!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ......Ufufu. Thank you for your concern.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But I am commpletely fine. 
The frustration, the impatience, the restlessness... it's alll quite all right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: After all, what I must put first is not "the now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The future of Mejiro. ——The destination that lies at the end of this path, waaay off in the distance.
I believe the "now" ought to be lived in service of reaching it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So this is fine as it is. I won't overexert myself.
For now, I'll simply gaze out at the changing seasons, at my leisure.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: While I wait for spring to come rolling back around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Waiting is something I'm good at, after alll. Ufufu.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
......I see...... that's remarkable.
You could say she has a powerful sense of purpose.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So that's... ah, I see.
Bright-san is——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(She must be moving forward even when she's resting.
One step, one step, toward the place she wants to reach.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ......Bright-san. I think I'll start valuing my rest more, too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Because I want to beat you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Not biting, huh.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes. They aren't biting.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
......Fufu. Still, what's come over you all of a sudden?
Asking me to teach you the secret to taking it easy.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
......I learned it from Bright-san.
That to win races, you need time like this too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So I came to you, Sky-san, since you're so good at taking it easy!
I'd like you to teach me the ins and outs of it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
......I see? I feel like I'm being ever so slightly not-complimented, but...
Huh? So you found yourself thinking you should stand still once in a while?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because a "now" like this is important too!
——In order to win next time!
